name: Rui
source:
Race: Unknown
Blood type: Unknown
Zodiac sign: Unknown
Age: Unknown
Weapon: Martial arts

Rui is a mysterious man who is found floating upon a raft one day and is taken aboard the Wing Sword. He is a smooth-talker and flirtatious to the others aboard the ship. When he fights, he uses martial arts, sometimes wearing his wooden clogs on his hands when he punches. In the evenings, he can be found under the stars playing an oriental instrument. But what is hidden beneath this strange romanticist?
